results.content:
Intermittent broadband support case

The connection drops on my wired computer too, mostly when it rains. Restarting the router did not help. Already checked: Restarted once and compared wired with wireless. I am angry about this experience and want it addressed.

results.resolution: Finding: Optical loss events align with rain; technician finds moisture at an external joint. Action: Dispatch an authorized technician to repair and seal the damaged joint. Simulated follow-up: no optical loss events during the next wet-weather observation.

results.content:
Intermittent broadband support case

Every evening the internet pauses on all devices, including my wired laptop. The optical light remains normal. Already checked: Tested Ethernet and stopped local downloads; stalls continue. I am frustrated with this problem and want a clear explanation.
results.title: Intermittent broadband support case
results.resolution: Finding: Line stays synchronized; provider monitoring shows peak-hour congestion on the access segment. Action: Network operations rebalance capacity and monitor the affected segment during peak hours. Simulated follow-up: peak-hour packet loss subsides and calls stay connected.
